title: Learned lexical writing with coordination attachment: bounded contract review
ownership: One bounded producer; root owns selection and experiments.
question: Is exclusively grammatical coordination attachment a materially new complete human writer, rather than a changed old function-word list?
decision: The elementary attachment operation already exists in1176P1 and in the corrected source evidence behind IDEA339. A complete ordinary-language scope lesson can be stated, but it is not a complete22-working-sign writer or a justified new frequency experiment. No card is added merely for replacing the old CONJ list by AND.
exposure: This review is after the recorded1176–79/1212/1221/1222/1223 results. They cannot become unseen evidence. No source or native counts, raw native text, image, encoder or new corpus were accessed. Existing949/950 remain unchanged.

navigation.limit: Bounded navigation and the named primaries, not an exhaustive novelty proof. Empty or unreviewed metadata is not evidence of an unexecuted experiment.

primary_comparisons.actual_contract: Finite invented seven-field recipe messages, usually rendered as five role words;64 plant names and finite material tables. The method itself says conditions, exceptions and unknown names remain outside that source language.
primary_comparisons.boundary: This is not ordinary open lexical prose with exclusively coordination attachment. Its failures do not exclude every lexical language, but a new language still owes its vocabulary, grammar and physical writing convention.

primary_comparisons.actual_contract: CONJ is exactly und/vnd/vnnd/unnd/vn/oder/aber. Consecutive exact listed tokens bind right to the next nonlisted word; punctuation-bearing/nonlisted forms close, recipe ends close a pending run. Ordered full source-word tuples remain recoverable.
primary_comparisons.boundary: The ordinary attachment idea is already tested on the frozen b4/w1 projections and failed the joint necessary conditions. Grammar-owned AND-only occurrences or full phrase scope are not literally this fixed spelling list, but that difference alone is not an independently justified new research direction.

primary_comparisons.actual_contracts: 1177 retained conjunctions, articles and13 prepositions;1178 bound alphabetic short-word runs;1179 used a distinct two-word pairing plus three complete word carriers;1212 retained44 right-bound spellings and seven fixed left-bound forms. These are not a new grammar-owned coordination scope rule.
primary_comparisons.boundary: All original failures stand. None grants a new list sweep, and a different source interpretation is not automatically an untouched source or independent confirmation.

primary_comparisons.actual_contract: Fourteen dependency relations include cc. A token follows eligible parent links to an anchor; only contiguous words with the same anchor merge, with punctuation barriers. Exact FORM sequence is preserved. This is not full-conjunct concatenation or coordination alone.
primary_comparisons.boundary: A grammatical coordinator already participates in a tested grammar-sensitive grouping family. Selecting only cc after seeing its14-relation failure would be a new informed subset, not a prior success or automatically motivated improvement.

primary_comparisons.actual_contract: One group per lexical analysis: lemma, UPOS, full FEATS, TraditionalMood and TraditionalTense, unknown-FORM fallback and attached punctuation. Never combine two lexical words. The inverse is that selected annotation stream, not full meaning or original FORM.
primary_comparisons.boundary: A coordinator attached to another lexical word changes this exact group contract, so1222 did not execute it. Its projected lexical analyses cannot silently supply intended scope, senses, resolved references or a learned22-sign morphology. No automatic conjunction repair follows its frequency failure.

primary_comparisons.actual_evidence: The corrected packet's Cross-record constraint architecture explicitly preserves a conjunction attached to the second word of the selected recto19/verso12 coordinated pair; verso19 is supplemental. The old raw-card hash is obsolete and not a verified current binding.
primary_comparisons.boundary: This is already retained source evidence for attached coordination and retained inflectional variation. It is not evidence of a Voynich coordinator, a complete open script, or the new bracket lesson below. No source language is selected.

primary_comparisons.actual_contracts: 032 already asks about a list under a shared predicate, but its endpoint and rival predictions are not independently bound.454 already preserves two opaque clauses under different connector classes.
primary_comparisons.boundary: Explicit coordination scope is not newly discovered here. Shared-predicate association cannot by itself distinguish a coordinator from an item noun. No new historical claim is inferred from the older source card alone.

paid_hand_lesson.purpose: Keep ordinary full lexical words and their inflections while visibly attaching AND to the next complete expression and preserving which two expressions it coordinates.
paid_hand_lesson.input: An authored message in a language already known by writer and reader, with actual full word forms, punctuation and intended binary AND constituent boundaries. The synthetic German lesson replaces only the exact ordinary coordinator und in a declared coordination; other connector spellings remain literal. A generalization would have to declare its one recoverable coordinator spelling beforehand. These examples are not a proposed source language. The writer supplies intended scope before writing; an automatic parser or annotation oracle is not assumed.
paid_hand_lesson.preserved: All ordinary word forms, order, inflections, negations and punctuation. Only the ordinary coordinator token is replaced by one explicit AND control. This does not normalize historical variants, merge senses or resolve pronouns. Identity and occurrence of an unknown name survive through its full spelling; spelling alone does not teach its referent or meaning.
controls: & separates its left expression and begins the right expression
backslash quotes the next literal control or backslash
writing: Write every ordinary word fully in the familiar orthography, retaining normal word spaces and punctuation.

For a declared binary AND expression with nonempty left and right arguments, write {LEFT &RIGHT}. The ampersand touches the first written character of RIGHT; there is no new space after it. LEFT and RIGHT may themselves contain complete nested coordinated expressions.
Every brace pair contains exactly one unescaped ampersand at its own nesting level. A longer list uses explicitly nested binary braces, never an unwritten associative grouping choice.
Escape a literal brace, ampersand or backslash. The structural controls are teaching marks, not free extra Voynich signs.

Keep ordinary visible sentence punctuation and word spaces. A physical line wrap changes no grammatical state; wrap only at an existing space. A word longer than the available writing width is outside this uncompleted physical carrier and must not silently gain a continuation convention.
reading: Scan escaped controls as literal characters; use balanced braces to recover each pair of explicit arguments.
Interpret the one unescaped ampersand at each brace level as AND between those arguments; insert the ordinary coordinator and its following word space when reading aloud.
Read all other words, inflections, negations, names and punctuation normally. Remove structural braces only after recording their scope. No lexical word becomes an entire unprinted clause.

complete_message.ordinary_message: Die kleinen Blätter und die rote Wurzel bleiben kalt. Erhitze die Wurzel nicht.
complete_message.handwritten_lesson: {Die kleinen Blätter &die rote Wurzel} bleiben kalt. Erhitze die Wurzel nicht.
complete_message.readback: The two full subject expressions are coordinated; the plural finite verb bleiben, plural kleinen Blätter, singular rote Wurzel and the second sentence's negation remain written. The recovered wording is exactly the displayed ordinary message. No new claim about actual leaves, roots or Voynich forms is made.

scope_contrast.declared_scope: AND(NOT(DRY(leaves)),COLD(leaves)); negation is part of the first conjunct.
NOT(AND(DRY(leaves),COLD(leaves))); negation precedes the whole coordinated predicate.

paid_hand_lesson.open_name_example: {Nera-vell &Tava} bleiben getrennt. Every character and the hyphen in the unfamiliar name are retained. Its real-world referent is not supplied by the notation.
paid_hand_lesson.learning_and_memory_cost: The ordinary language's lexicon, all relevant inflected forms or productive inflection rules and its normal spelling remain learned knowledge. Additional cost: four reserved control/escape actions, recognition of two actual conjunct spans and a visible bracket stack when nested. No counter, hidden reset, word-rank table, arbitrary whole-message ID or frequency-selected alias is supplied.
paid_hand_lesson.physical_group_consequence: Inner word spaces stay real visible spaces. The right conjunction attaches only to the following first written unit; the complete RIGHT phrase is not one huge printed word. Treating an entire brace span as a native space group would be a different, unpaid grouping assumption.
paid_hand_lesson.shape_limits: Unmarked ordinary lexical repetitions remain repeatable; ordinary word lengths and diverse interior letters remain possible in the familiar orthography. These statements are not a demonstration under the22-working-sign repertoire. The module neither enforces two terminal glyphs nor a three-glyph medial alphabet, but it supplies no actual native glyph compatibility.

free_assumptions_and_unpaid_parts: A writer and reader know the same ordinary lexical language; no particular language is favored by this review.
The intended coordination structure belongs to the authored input. Existing source annotations do not automatically supply every such semantic distinction.
Binary scope and visible controls are deliberate teaching conventions, not medieval attestation from the PGP example.
A physical22-sign realization of ordinary lexical words, inflection, punctuation, control escaping and overwide words is absent. The ordinary alphabet cannot be silently counted as that realization.
No native written group has been identified with a source word, a prefix-bearing word or a whole coordinated expression.
All previously exposed source results remain known. A later experiment would need its own prospective claim and cannot call this an unexposed rescue of1222.
smallest_decision_changing_obligation: Before selecting another frequency trial, choose whether the claim is merely right-word attachment or recovery of actual complete coordination scope. The former is already represented by1176P1 and the historical339 source construction; the latter must carry the displayed scope boundaries or explicitly preserve an ambiguity, and has no paid22-sign writer here. Hand-readable output alone does not settle the source/group mapping or select a writer.
retention: Existing raw339/454 and curated032 remain at their current statuses. The lesson records the concrete construction boundary; it does not add a duplicate proposal, repair any failed contract, or authorize a new experiment.
